PluginInfo.Name: Terminal (based on iTerm2)
PluginInfo.ShortDescription: Connect to SSH, Telnet and Serial Port hosts.
PluginInfo.Description:
SSH, Telnet, Serial Port connections and custom terminals at your fingertips.

The iTerm2 based Terminal Plugin supports SSH, Telnet, Serial port (RS232) or any other terminal-based connection type using a Custom Terminal.

Customization
  • Font, font size and styles can be customized
  • Configurable ANSI color palette
  • Support for iTerm2 color schemes

Input
  • Support for configuring key mappings
  • Use key sequence tasks to automate keyboard input
  • Customizable keyboard behavior
  • Customizable scrollback lines

Log Management
  • Create and organize log files for documentation needs
  • Log dashboard provides easy log file access and management
  • View, search and export log files

Advanced Features
  • Support for embedding private key files into documents
  • X11 forwarding support
  • Encoding and terminal type configuration
  • Connection-specific settings (such as keepalives)
  • Tunnel configuration
  • Configuration for serial port communication
  • Support for iTerm2 Triggers
  • Support for iTerm2 Shell Integration Features
  • Secure Gateway support
